entry.title: Acrocorinth

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: The inspected aerial picture confirms the twin rocky ridge, terrain-following curtains, three successive western gates and small southwest keep. Standard viewer PMTiles set approximate ridge fit in the retained site frame. The runtime derivative omits the embedded research terrain mesh and samples its architectural footing functions directly from standard viewer PMTiles, using a0.7m working clearance. The old relative258.37m datum remains only in the preserved source master. The broad site ring is contextual; footprint replacement stays off. Anchor 22.873283683,37.891346465; heading -0.026117351143; standard PMTiles datum 510.43219632278726m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
